# Senior AI Engineer (m/w/d)

Fictional posting used by the job-description matching tests.

## What you'll do

- Build agents on large language models with tool calling and MCP.
- Design retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines on vector databases.
- Own evals and observability (Langfuse or LangSmith) for every release.

## What you bring

- Python and TypeScript, FastAPI, Docker and Kubernetes on AWS.
- Continuous integration with GitHub Actions; BM25 or hybrid search.
- Fluent English.

## Nice to have

- Fine-tuning (LoRA), Terraform, SageMaker.
- German is a plus.

## What we offer

Hybrid work in Berlin, a learning budget and a JobRad. We are an equal opportunity employer.
